title: Platform identity, analytics, and role-language checkpoint
content:
This was a platform infrastructure checkpoint rather than a single-app release. The work centered on how the JeffersonWM ecosystem presents itself publicly, how it can be measured carefully, and how role language reads across apps.

What changed:

  • Identity files went live: JeffersonWM now publishes robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, and about-for-ai.md so crawlers, search engines, and AI systems have a clearer first description of the platform.
  • Analytics started small: Google Analytics G-V3NQ37RBWY was added to the public first tier: WMJefferson, Dooky Detective, Jeffershizzle, Feed, Project Activity, and the JeffersonWM app surface.
  • Private surfaces stayed deliberate: deeper app/admin analytics were not added yet; the next decision is whether they provide enough value to justify tracking beyond the public layer.
  • Role language was simplified: preferred admin / pref admin now reads as owner, and regular admin / reg admin now reads as admin across active surfaces and public notes.
  • Perihelion got a second pass: folder-permission badges and account labels were rechecked so the UI consistently shows Owner, Admin, and User.

The important direction is that the sites are starting to describe themselves as one coherent public ecosystem, not just separate apps. Identity, analytics, DNS readiness, and role language are all part of making the platform easier to understand from the outside without overreaching into private/admin behavior too early.
